claims: European qualifying for the 2026 FIFA World Cup is complete.
16 UEFA teams earned spots in the 48-team 2026 FIFA World Cup tournament.
The 2026 FIFA World Cup tournament locations are USA, Mexico, Canada.
There are 16 European spots in the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
The playoff format for European qualifying was single-leg semi-finals on March 26, 2026 and finals on March 31, 2026.
The 12 group runners-up and four UEFA Nations League teams competed in single-leg knockout paths in the March 2026 playoffs.
The 2026 World Cup qualified European teams group winners are Austria, Belgium, Croatia, England, France, Germany, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Scotland, Spain, Switzerland.
The playoff winners are Bosnia and Herzegovina, Czechia, Sweden, Turkey.
Bosnia and Herzegovina defeated Italy 1-1, 4-1 on penalties in the March 2026 playoffs.
Sweden defeated Poland 3-2 in the March 2026 playoffs.
Czechia defeated Denmark 2-2, 3-1 on penalties in the March 2026 playoffs.
Turkey defeated Kosovo 1-0 in the March 2026 playoffs.
Italy failed to qualify for a third consecutive World Cup after their playoff loss to Bosnia and Herzegovina.
